kind: Hội thoại 2 người bạn về bóng đá
L: A
Hey Ben, did you watch the match last night?
B
Yeah! That last goal was unreal.
A
I know, right? Anyway, we need one more player on Sunday.
B
For the five-a-side game? Count me in!
A
Awesome. We kick off at nine, so don't sleep in.
B
Nine? On a Sunday? Ugh, fine. I'll set an alarm.

exq.q: What is the problem with Sunday?
exq.why: “we need one more player on Sunday” = chủ nhật thiếu một người.

exq.q: What time does the game start?
exq.why: “We kick off at nine” = chín giờ bắt đầu.

exq.q: What will Ben do so he does not oversleep?
exq.why: “I'll set an alarm” = tớ sẽ đặt báo thức.

exq.q: What does Ben say about Kim last time?
exq.why: “You were terrible last time” = lần trước cậu đá tệ.
